email_draft.subject: Buckeye Online's SPED team, paperwork cut in half | Journify
email_draft.body:
A colleague flagged Buckeye Online Learning Co. as a potential partner, and I wanted to check directly with your team before assuming anything about how your SPED services are structured.

Virtual schools carrying direct IEP responsibility in Ohio face a documentation problem that in-person districts don't: asynchronous teams, remote parent communication, and progress monitoring that falls entirely on case managers with no shared system. If your staff hold IEP responsibility in-house, Journify sits on top of your existing IEP system and gives every case manager, SPED teacher, and related-service provider a shared workspace. Most teams cut their documentation time by up to 50%, so the people who chose this field actually get to do it.

Before I say anything else, can you point me to the right person to confirm whether your team directly employs SPED staff and holds IEP responsibility, or is a quick five-minute call the faster path?
email_draft.hook_summary: Partnership team referral with explicit segment-qualification uncertainty; hook leads with a direct, honest acknowledgment rather than a fabricated signal.
